lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Hi Angela. Is now still okay?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Now's great. I've got the checklist open. How'd the Ducal call go?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Really well, actually. He knows exactly what he wants, which is a gift. Anyway. Where are we?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: So I just moved us to eighty-five percent. Release notes, store listing, rollout plan, all checked off. The two big ones left are forty-eight hours crash-free and QA sign-off.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: And Balthasar's still good for Thursday at three thirty?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Three thirty, yep. He'll sign off then, assuming the old tablet behaves. I'm booking it for the three of us this afternoon.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Is he running it now? He said eleven.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Right now, yeah. All six devices, with Tybalt's branch on the old one. He'll post in the channel when he's done.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Great. And go or no-go doesn't move?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Friday, nine thirty. Unless something catches fire, it doesn't move.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Let's not set anything on fire.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Ha. Noted. And the rollout plan's the boring one we talked about. Ten percent first, then everybody, if the crash numbers stay quiet.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Boring is good. I like boring this week.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Um, the other thing. The announcement. I'd like to draft it so it's ready, but I won't send anything until we've actually said go.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Yes, perfect. Draft it, send it after the go.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: That's the plan.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: One ask from me. The old Android 11 tablet, the one that kept crashing. Can we add it to the standing device list? So it gets tested every release, not just when someone remembers it's in the drawer.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Oh, good call. That's the one that caught the camera crash. I'll add it today.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Where does it live, anyway?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: In my desk drawer. With a sticky note on it that says do not recycle.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Good. Let's keep it that way for a while.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Thank you. I left the same note on Tybalt's pull request, for CI.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Then I'll match whatever he does. Same tablet on both lists.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Perfect. Anything you need from me before Friday?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Honestly? Just show up at nine thirty. Oh, and if you see anything odd in the crash digest, forward it to me. Don't just, you know, file it in your head.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Ha. Fair. Will do.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Okay, that's me. Go write your spec.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Going. Thanks, Angela.
